--CREATE TABLE D360.SYN_STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER
--WITH(
--    DISTRIBUTION= ROUND_ROBIN,
--    HEAP
--)AS
--SELECT * FROM SYN.STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER WHERE 1=0 
--
--SELECT * FROM  D360.SYN_STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER
--
--SELECT A.COLUMN_NAME,A.DATA_TYPE,A.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,A.NUMERIC_PRECISION,A.NUMERIC_SCALE,B.COLUMN_NAME,B.DATA_TYPE,B.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,B.NUMERIC_PRECISION,B.NUMERIC_SCALE FROM (
--SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'SYN' AND TABLE_NAME = 'STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER')A 
--JOIN (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'D360' AND TABLE_NAME = 'SYN_STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER') B
--ON A.COLUMN_NAME = B.COLUMN_NAME AND A.ORDINAL_POSITION = B.ORDINAL_POSITION

DECLARE @DATETOPROCESS DATE
SET @DATETOPROCESS = '2026-05-27';

TRUNCATE TABLE D360.SYN_STG_CCD_DCUSTOMER;

INSERT INTO D360.SYN_STG_CCD_DCUSTOMER--SYN.STG_CCD_DCUSTOMER

select 
 CUST_NBR
,ISNULL(CUST_CIF_NBR,'') AS CUST_CIF_NBR
,CUST_LOCAL_NAME
,CUST_ENG_NAME
,CUST_ADDR1
,CUST_ADDR2
,CUST_ADD_CITY
,CUST_ADD_PROVINCE
,CUST_ADD_ZIPCODE
,CUST_PHONE
,LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR,CUST_DTE_BIRTH,112),6) AS CUST_DTE_BIRTH
,CUST_MADDR1
,CUST_MADDR2
,CUST_MADD_CITY
,CUST_MADD_PROVINCE
,CUST_MADD_ZIPCODE
,CUST_CNAME
,CUST_CPHONE
,CUST_ADDR3
,CUST_ADDR4
,CUST_MADDR3
,CUST_MADDR4
,CUST_EMAIL_ADDR
,CUST_MOBILE_PHONE
,CUST_FIRST_NAME
,CUST_MIDDLE_NAME
,CUST_LAST_NAME
,CUST_EMAIL_ADDR2
,CUST_EMAIL_ADDR3
,CUST_PHONE_CTY
,CUST_PHONE_AREA
,CUST_MOBILE_CTY
,CUST_MOBILE_AREA
,CUST_OFFICE_CTY
,CUST_OFFICE_AREA
,CUST_TITLE
,CUST_DATE_MAINT
,LEFT(CUST.FILE_NAME,5) AS BANK_CODE 
,CUST.SOURCE_CODE 
,NULL AS TABLE_NAME
,CUST.FILE_NAME
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) AS insert_dttm
from EDS.CCD_CUSTOMER CUST
--JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM EDD ON EDD.YYYYMM = CONCAT(DATEPART(yyyy,DATEADD(mm,-1,@DATETOPROCESS  )),DATEPART(mm,DATEADD(mm,-1,@DATETOPROCESS  ))) AND EDD.MONTH_END = 'Y'--CCF.AS_OF_DATE  
LEFT JOIN EDS.CCD_ACCOUNTS ACCT ON CUST.CUST_NBR = ACCT.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    AND COALESCE(CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE,'') NOT LIKE 'TES%'
    AND COALESCE(CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE,'') NOT LIKE 'TST%'
    AND COALESCE(CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE,'') NOT LIKE 'XXX%'
    AND ACCT.AS_OF_DATE = @DATETOPROCESS
WHERE   --CCF.AS_OF_DATE = FULLDATE
    COALESCE(CUST_LOCAL_NAME,'') NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND COALESCE(CUST_FIRST_NAME,'') NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND COALESCE(CUST_MIDDLE_NAME,'') NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND COALESCE(CUST_LAST_NAME,'') NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND @DATETOPROCESS BETWEEN CUST.SCD_Start_Date AND CUST.SCD_End_Date



SELECT DISTINCT
CUST_NBR
,ISNULL(CUST_CIF_NBR,'') AS CUST_CIF_NBR
,CUST_LOCAL_NAME
,CUST_ENG_NAME
,CUST_ADDR1
,CUST_ADDR2
,CUST_ADD_CITY
,CUST_ADD_PROVINCE
,CUST_ADD_ZIPCODE
,CUST_PHONE
,LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR,CUST_DTE_BIRTH),6) AS CUST_DTE_BIRTH
,CUST_MADDR1
,CUST_MADDR2
,CUST_MADD_CITY
,CUST_MADD_PROVINCE
,CUST_MADD_ZIPCODE
,CUST_CNAME
,CUST_CPHONE
,CUST_ADDR3
,CUST_ADDR4
,CUST_MADDR3
,CUST_MADDR4
,CUST_EMAIL_ADDR
,CUST_MOBILE_PHONE
,CUST_FIRST_NAME
,CUST_MIDDLE_NAME
,CUST_LAST_NAME
,CUST_EMAIL_ADDR2
,CUST_EMAIL_ADDR3
,CUST_PHONE_CTY
,CUST_PHONE_AREA
,CUST_MOBILE_CTY
,CUST_MOBILE_AREA
,CUST_OFFICE_CTY
,CUST_OFFICE_AREA
,CUST_TITLE
,CUST_DATE_MAINT
,BNK_CODE AS BANK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,NULL AS TABLE_NAME
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER A
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CRDACCT_CUST_NBR,CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP WHERE ISLATEST = 1 ) B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR
WHERE A.ISLATEST = 1 
    AND A.CUST_LOCAL_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND A.CUST_FIRST_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND A.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND A.CUST_LAST_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    AND ((B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TES%' 
    AND B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TST%' 
    AND B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'XXX%') OR B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR IS NULL)
